row.evidence: LinkedIn's SCIM guide documents a bearer-token SCIM endpoint (https://api.linkedin.com/scim) for Entra ID and Okta that creates users, assigns and revokes licenses and syncs groups, but no LinkedIn page says which plan includes SCIM or SSO.
row.notes: SCIM is well documented, but the plan gate is not published: the Teams page ($379.88 per seat/year, up to 20 licenses) and the compare-plans page (business plan is Contact sales) never mention SSO or SCIM, so status stays unknown rather than gated. Deprovisioning revokes the licence; SCIM cannot delete users or assign permissions. LinkedIn officially supports Entra ID and Okta; OneLogin works only via OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML' app, and Okta needs a custom SAML app because the OIN LinkedIn Learning app is SAML only. SSO is 'preferred', not required. There is no non-SCIM user-management API: the Learning APIs cover content and activity reporting. Other sync: CSV, SFTP, HTTPS, Workday and SuccessFactors.

auth.token_source: LinkedIn Learning admin > Authentication > Automate user management > Configure SCIM > Add SCIM > Generate token (Full Admin only)

operations.notes: Update is documented ('Automatically update user attributes: Yes') without saying PUT or PATCH.

deprovision.notes: Deprovisioning removes the user's LinkedIn Learning licence; user deletion is not supported over SCIM.

custom.how: Custom attributes are documented via CSV upload or SSO attribute mapping, not via SCIM.

roles.how: 'Assign permissions' and 'Change or revoke permissions' are listed as not supported.

limitations.text: Officially supported IdPs are Azure AD (Entra ID) and Okta; other IdPs must ask their Customer Success Manager.
SCIM cannot delete users or assign/revoke permissions; group assignment by attribute rules is not supported.
Okta's catalogue LinkedIn Learning app does not support SCIM; a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning is required.
OneLogin's native LinkedIn Learning app does not support SCIM; use the generic SCIM Provisioner with SAML app.

scim.notes: Version 2.0 inferred from the enterprise extension URNs (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0) in the attribute mapping and OneLogin's 'SCIM v2 Enterprise' app; sso_required false because SSO is listed as '(preferred)'.

user_api.notes: The documented LinkedIn Learning APIs are content (learningAssets, learningClassifications) and activity-report APIs (c26); no non-SCIM user-management API is documented.

okta.notes: OIN app ticks SAML only; LinkedIn's guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning instead (row idp.okta = via_generic).

entra.notes: LinkedIn's guide provisions through the gallery LinkedIn Learning app's Provisioning tab; Microsoft's own tutorial covers SSO and JIT only.

google.notes: Google SSO is supported (c25); Google catalogue app not checked.

onelogin.notes: From LinkedIn's guide; OneLogin's own connector page not loaded. SCIM via OneLogin's generic SCIM Provisioner app (row idp.onelogin = via_generic).

fallbacks.other_sync: SFTP, HTTPS, Workday and SuccessFactors learner sync
